# Vendored Libraries

- SortableJS 1.15.6: https://github.com/SortableJS/Sortable (MIT), downloaded from jsDelivr.
- QRCode.js 1.0.0: https://github.com/davidshimjs/qrcodejs (MIT), downloaded from cdnjs. QR generation is entirely local.
- Lucide UMD: copied from the existing Huck vendored distribution (ISC); https://lucide.dev/license.

Firebase SDK 13.2.0 is dynamically loaded from Google's official gstatic CDN only when configured and not in the local sandbox. No authentication SDK or privileged key is used.
